mechanism: Nicotine induces CYP1A2 which metabolizes fluphenazine, potentially reducing antipsychotic efficacy; nicotine also increases dopaminergic activity which may counteract fluphenazine's antipsychotic effects.
action: Monitor psychiatric symptoms closely in smoking patients; consider higher fluphenazine doses or smoking cessation counseling; assess efficacy regularly as nicotine may reduce fluphenazine plasma concentrations.
